papers.title: Production of Ni-Cr Metal Powder by Selective Laser Melting for Dentistry to Observation of Characteristics
papers.abstract: Purpose: The selective laser melting (SLM) process for dentistry, which is one of the additive manufacturing technologies (AM) allows for rapid production of a three-dimensional model with complex shape by directly melting metal powder. This process generates detailed items of a three-dimensional model shape through consolidation of a thin powder layer by utilizing both selective melting and laser beam simultaneously. In regard to SLM process, Fe-base powder, Ti-6AI-4V powder, AI-base powder, etc. have been researched. It is believed that the aforementioned technologies will be widely utilized in manufacturing metal parts using metal powder of raw material. This study chose Ni-Cr-Mo metal powder in order to manufacture metal powder materials that would be used in the selective laser melting for dentistry. Methods: This study manufactured metal powder using mechanical alloying technique (MA) among those metal powder manufacturing techniques. Moreover, this study aimed to utilize the metal powder manufactured after observing the characteristics of powder as preliminary data of Ni-Cr-Mo metal powder. This study could obtain the following conclusions within the experimental limitations. Results: As a result of mechanically alloying Ni-Cr-Mo powder over time, its mean particle size was <TEX>$66.93{\mu}m$</TEX> <TEX>$54.4{\mu}m$</TEX> and <TEX>$45.39{\mu}m$</TEX> at 10h, 20h and 30h, respectively. The gtain form of metal powder by mechanical alloying technique was a sponge-like shape of irregular plate; however, the gtain form manufactured by high-pressure water aromization process had the following three types: globular type, chain type and oval type. Conclusion: This study found <TEX>$37.65{\mu}m$</TEX> as the mean particle size of Ni-Cr-Mo metal powder, which was manufactured using water atomization technique under the following conditions: water atomization flux of 300 liter/min, hydraulic pressure of <TEX>$400kgf/cm^2$</TEX> and injection angle of <TEX>$45^{\circ}$</TEX>. This study confirmed that the grain form of powder (solid particle form) would vary depending on the manufacturing process.

llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on powder production and characterization, lacking LPBF fabrication, mechanical testing, stress shielding analysis, and any biomedical implant context required for am_biomedical direction.

summary_zh.motivation: 制备用于牙科选择性激光熔融的Ni-Cr-Mo金属粉末。
summary_zh.method: 采用机械合金化（MA）和水雾化法制备粉末并表征其粒径和形貌。
summary_zh.result: 不同工艺下粉末平均粒径在37.65-66.93μm之间，颗粒形态各异。
summary_zh.validation: 仅对粉末特性进行测量，无后续LPBF打印或力学验证。

summary_en.motivation: To produce Ni-Cr-Mo metal powder suitable for selective laser melting in dentistry by characterizing powder properties.
summary_en.method: Mechanical alloying and high-pressure water atomization were used to fabricate metal powder, and particle size and morphology were observed.
summary_en.result: Mean particle sizes ranged from 37.65 to 66.93 μm depending on process, with distinct powder morphologies.
summary_en.validation: Only powder characteristics were measured; no further validation of LPBF fabrication or mechanical properties.

papers.title: Diagnóstico de infección periprotésica utilizando proteína C - reactiva sinovial
papers.abstract: Synovial quantification of C Reactive Protein (SCRP) has been recently published with high sensitivity and specificity in the diagnosis of periprosthetic joint infection. However, there are no studies comparing the usefulness of this test with intra operative frozen section (FS), which has been used as gold standard to rule out infections at our center. We asked whether intraoperative SCRP could lead to similar sensitivity, specificity, and predictive values as intraoperative FS in revision total hip arthroplasty (THA). A prospective and comparative study (study level II) was performed including 76 patients who underwent a hip revision surgery for any cause. SCRP quantification and the analysis of FS of intraoperative samples were performed in all the patients. The definitive diagnosis of an infection was determined according to the Musculoskeletal Infection Society. We found infection in 23 patients. At a threshold of SCRP of 9.5 mg/L the sensitivity was 90% (CI 95%:70.8-98.6%), the specificity was 94% (CI 95%: 84.5-98.7%), the positive predictive value was 87% (CI95%: 66.3- 97%) and the negative predictive value was 96% (CI95%: 8799.4%), being exactly the same results when we confronted SCRP values with FS analysis. The positive LRatio was 16.36 (CI 95%=5.4-49.5), and the negative LRatio was 0.10 (CI 95%= 0.03-0.36). The quantification of SCRP has similar sensitivity, specificity and predictive values as frozen section, with the advantages of being a simple and economic test, widely available in different centers, where frozen section analysis may not be accesible

summary_zh.motivation: 评估滑液C反应蛋白在髋关节翻修术中诊断假体周围感染的价值
summary_zh.method: 前瞻性比较研究，对76例髋关节翻修患者同时进行滑液CRP检测和术中冰冻切片分析
summary_zh.result: 滑液CRP阈值9.5 mg/L时，敏感性和特异性分别达90%和94%，与冰冻切片结果一致
summary_zh.validation: 以肌肉骨骼感染学会标准为金标准，与冰冻切片结果进行对比验证

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the diagnostic value of synovial C-reactive protein (SCRP) for periprosthetic joint infection in revision total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: A prospective comparative study with 76 patients undergoing hip revision, measuring SCRP and analyzing frozen sections intraoperatively.
summary_en.result: At a threshold of 9.5 mg/L, SCRP showed 90% sensitivity and 94% specificity, matching the performance of frozen section analysis.
summary_en.validation: Validation against the Musculoskeletal Infection Society criteria, with comparison to intraoperative frozen section as reference.
